youtube.title: Which country has the most bird species? Not the Amazon one 🔭
youtube.description:
The rainforest giant, the island nation of thousands, or the third one? One country holds about a fifth of every bird species on Earth, more hummingbirds than anywhere else, and new species are still being described from its hills. The reason is not jungle — it is three walls of mountains.
Which did you pick?
